verdict_rationale: TX TDLR (Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation) is a Texas state government agency. All license records are mandatory public disclosures under Texas Government Code §552 (Public Information Act). TDLR explicitly publishes its license database as a public bulk download on data.texas.gov with no access restrictions. The data contains: license holder name, license type, license number, business address, business phone, expiration date — all standard public regulatory fields. No SSNs, DOB, financial accounts, or home addresses (business address only). Precedent: NPPES (CMS federal licensing), FAA aircraft registration, FL DBPR all approved on same grounds. Commercially, InfoUSA/ZoomInfo/DataAxle resell equivalent data from this source. PASS.

pii_check.notes: Business address and phone from government license record. Individual electricians are license holders — their info is regulatory public disclosure, same as doctor NPI records.
